notes: «فقال ابن طاوس» is the same man as «عبد الله بن طاوس» (the fuller form is kept once)
the scene («صلى إلى جنبي», «فقلت لوهيب بن خالد») does not add links; Wuhayb speaks only in the scene

the last link is uncertain: Ibn Abbas is named as the man whose practice the father saw, and «ولا أعلم إلا أنه قال» leaves open who said the Prophet did it; not ruled, because the words are a practice described, not a saying in dispute
the editor's glosses «- المعنى -» and «- يعني السعدي -» are left out
